account.description: Optional named account label from ai-usagebar. Leave empty for the default account. Ignored when the provider is Automatic.
account.label: Account label

bar_font_scale.description: Adjusts font and icon sizes for this specific bar capsule.
bar_font_scale.label: Capsule font size

color_by_usage.description: Tints the reading as the quota gets tight. Off keeps the capsule in the bar's own colour.
color_by_usage.label: Color by usage

extras.description: The time left in the window, how far the spend is from the clock, both, or neither.
extras.label: Extra reading

font_scale.description: Adjusts font and icon sizes proportionally across the panel and bar.
font_scale.label: Font size

gearing_anthropic.description: Estimated full 5h sessions per weekly quota for Claude Pro. The panel displays whole numbers; calculations and automatic calibration retain decimal precision.
gearing_anthropic.label: Gearing ratio: Claude Pro (sessions/wk)

gearing_claude_oss.description: Estimated full 5h sessions per weekly quota for Claude & GPT OSS. The panel displays whole numbers; calculations and automatic calibration retain decimal precision.
gearing_claude_oss.label: Gearing ratio: Claude & GPT OSS (sessions/wk)

gearing_default.description: Estimated full 5h sessions per weekly quota for unlisted models. The panel displays whole numbers; calculations and automatic calibration retain decimal precision.
gearing_default.label: Gearing ratio: Default (sessions/wk)

gearing_gemini.description: Estimated full 5h sessions per weekly quota for Gemini. The panel displays whole numbers; calculations and automatic calibration retain decimal precision.
gearing_gemini.label: Gearing ratio: Gemini (sessions/wk)

gearing_openai.description: Estimated full 5h sessions per weekly quota for OpenAI / Codex. The panel displays whole numbers; calculations and automatic calibration retain decimal precision.
gearing_openai.label: Gearing ratio: Codex / OpenAI (sessions/wk)

glyph_position.description: Which side of the reading the icon sits on.
glyph_position.label: Icon position

hidden_services.description: Comma-separated list of provider or model IDs to hide from both the bar and panel (e.g. claude-oss, moonshot).
hidden_services.label: Hidden services & models

hide_claude_oss.description: Hides the Claude & GPT OSS tier from Antigravity in both the bar and panel, keeping Gemini active.
hide_claude_oss.label: Hide Claude & GPT OSS

meal_pause_hours.description: Estimated inactive hours during daytime for lunch, dinner, or rest breaks.
meal_pause_hours.label: Daily meal & break pause (hours)

provider_limit.description: How many providers one capsule shows, busiest first, with a +N for the rest. Only applies when the provider is Automatic.
provider_limit.label: Providers in the capsule

query_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for all providers. Increase for many accounts or slow Antigravity startup.
query_timeout_seconds.label: Quota query timeout (seconds)

refresh_minutes.description: How often the CLI is asked for fresh usage. Countdowns tick locally between calls.
refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)

schedule_aware_triage.description: Discount sleep, meals, and off-hours to pace quota consumption against real active working hours.
schedule_aware_triage.label: Schedule-aware triage

show_glyph.description: The provider's icon. Off leaves the reading on its own.
show_glyph.label: Show icon

show_name.description: Adds the product name next to the percentage, so two capsules do not look alike.
show_name.label: Show provider name

show_value.description: The percentage as text. Off leaves the gauge to say it.
show_value.label: Show value

sleep_end_hour.description: Hour when active usage resumes in the morning on weekdays (e.g. 8 for 8 AM).
sleep_end_hour.label: Wake / active hours resume (weekdays)

sleep_start_hour.description: Hour when sleep or off-hours begin on weekdays (e.g. 0 for midnight, 23 for 11 PM).
sleep_start_hour.label: Sleep / off-hours start (weekdays)

style.description: How this capsule looks in the bar.
style.label: Style

vendor.description: Which plan this capsule tracks. Add the widget twice to watch two.
vendor.label: Provider

visualization.description: A gauge beside the reading, or nothing.
visualization.label: Visualization

weekend_sleep_end_hour.description: Hour when active usage resumes on weekends (e.g. 9 for 9 AM).
weekend_sleep_end_hour.label: Wake / active hours resume (weekends)

weekend_sleep_start_hour.description: Hour when sleep or off-hours begin on weekends (e.g. 1 for 1 AM).
weekend_sleep_start_hour.label: Sleep / off-hours start (weekends)

action.credentials: Check the saved credentials and file permissions in ai-usagebar, then refresh.
action.local_server: Open Antigravity or an agy session, sign in if needed, then refresh.
action.login: Sign in from a terminal, then refresh:
action.missing_key: Check this provider’s API key in ai-usagebar, then refresh.
action.named_account: Reconnect account {account} in ai-usagebar, then refresh.
action.network: Check the internet connection, VPN or proxy, then refresh.
action.permission: Check the account’s permissions and subscription, then refresh.
action.rate_limited: Wait for the retry window. The next automatic refresh will try again.
action.reconnect: Sign in again in the provider’s app or CLI, then refresh.
action.schema: Update ai-usagebar and refresh. If it persists, report the response format error.
action.server: Wait for the provider to recover, then refresh.
action.timeout: Check the connection and provider availability, then refresh. Increase the query timeout if it keeps happening.
action.unknown: Refresh and check the provider’s status if the problem persists.

error.no_data_hint: ai-usagebar ran but reported no usage. Check the providers in `~/.config/ai-usagebar/config.toml`.
error.not_installed_hint: The CLI is not on PATH. Install it, then try again.
error.spawn_failed_hint: The process never started. Try again in a moment.
error.timed_out_hint: The read took too long. A provider may be answering slowly.

ui.hidden_value: {count} more, click to open the panel
ui.plan_changed: The plan changed; readings taken under the previous one were dropped.
ui.title: AI Triage
